source: interface IItem {public int V {get;}}
class Box<T> {public T Value;}
class Item : IItem {public int V=0;public int Read(){return V;}public bool SelfReplace(Holder h){h.Pair=(new Item(),2);V=7;return V==7;}}
class Parent {public Item Child=new Item();}
class Generic<T> {public List<(T,int)> Rows=[];}
class Bag2 {public List<Item> Items=[new Item()];public Dictionary<string,Item> Map={"k":new Item()};public List<List<Item>> LL=[[new Item()]];}

class Holder {public (List<int>,int) IntPair=([],0);public (Parent,Item) PI=(new Parent(),new Item());public bool ReplaceReattach(){Item a=Pair.Item1;Pair=(new Item(),2);a.V=7;Pair=(a,3);return Pair.Item1==a&&Pair.Item1.V==7&&Pair.Item2==3;}public (IItem,int) IPair=(new Item(),0);public (int,int) Numbers=(1,2);public List<((Item,int),int)> NRows=[];public (Item,int) Pair=(new Item(),0);public ((Item,int),int) Nested=((new Item(),0),0);public (Item,Item) Two=(new Item(),new Item());public (Item?,int) Maybe=(null,0);public (Parent,int) ParentPair=(new Parent(),0);public (List<Item>,int) ListPair=([],0);public (Dictionary<string,Item>,int) MapPair=({},0);public List<(Item,int)> Rows=[];public Dictionary<string,(Item,int)> Map={};public List<Item> Items=[];public bool ReplaceRead(){Item a=Pair.Item1;Pair=(new Item(),2);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&Pair.Item1.V==0;}public Item ReplaceReturn(){Item a=Pair.Item1;Pair=(new Item(),2);a.V=7;return a;}}
class Probe {
public static bool IntListAliasInTuple(){Holder h=new Holder();h.IntPair=([1],1);List<int> l=h.IntPair.Item1;h.IntPair=([],2);l.Add(3);return l.Count==2&&l[1]==3&&h.IntPair.Item1.Count==0;}
public static bool ListFieldReassign(){Bag2 b=new Bag2();Item a=b.Items[0];b.Items=[new Item()];a.V=7;return a.V==7&&b.Items[0].V==0&&b.Items.Count==1;}
public static bool DictFieldReassign(){Bag2 b=new Bag2();Item a=b.Map["k"];b.Map={};a.V=7;return a.V==7&&b.Map.Count==0;}
public static bool NestedListEntryReassign(){Bag2 b=new Bag2();Item a=b.LL[0][0];b.LL[0]=[];a.V=7;return a.V==7&&b.LL[0].Count==0;}
public static bool OuterAliasInnerReplace(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.Pair.Item1;Swap(h);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&h.Pair.Item1.V==0;}
public static bool ThisReplace(){Holder h=new Holder();return h.Pair.Item1.SelfReplace(h)&&h.Pair.Item1.V==0;}
public static bool RetainReattachReplace(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.Pair.Item1;h.Pair=(new Item(),2);h.Pair=(a,3);h.Pair=(new Item(),4);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&h.Pair.Item1.V==0&&h.Pair.Item2==4;}

public static bool SiblingsSplit(){Holder h=new Holder();Parent p=h.PI.Item1;Item c=h.PI.Item2;h.PI=(new Parent(),new Item());p.Child.V=5;c.V=6;return p.Child.V==5&&c.V==6&&h.PI.Item1.Child.V==0&&h.PI.Item2.V==0;}
public static bool ReattachMethod(){return new Holder().ReplaceReattach();}
public static bool Reattach(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.Pair.Item1;h.Pair=(new Item(),2);a.V=7;h.Pair=(a,3);return h.Pair.Item1==a&&h.Pair.Item1.V==7;}
public static bool InterfaceChild(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.IPair=(a,1);IItem i=h.IPair.Item1;h.IPair=(new Item(),2);a.V=7;return i.V==7&&i==a;}

public static bool GenericClassChild(){Generic<Box<int>>g=new Generic<Box<int>>();Box<int>a=new Box<int>(){Value=0};a.Value=7;g.Rows.Add((a,1));g.Rows[0]=(new Box<int>(){Value=0},2);return a.Value==7;}
public static bool TupleWithOnlyPrimitives(){Holder h=new Holder();h.Numbers=(3,4);return h.Numbers.Item1==3;}
public static bool ListOfRetained(){Holder h=new Holder();List<Item>a=[];for(int i=0;i<5;i++){a.Add(h.Pair.Item1);h.Pair=(new Item(),i);}a[0].V=7;return a[0].V==7&&a[4].V==0&&h.Pair.Item1.V==0;}
public static bool NestedTupleInList(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.NRows.Add(((a,1),2));h.NRows[0]=((new Item(),3),4);return a.V==0;}
public static bool HelperReturn(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=Replace(h);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&h.Pair.Item1.V==0;}
public static bool Field(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.Pair.Item1;h.Pair=(new Item(),2);return a.V==0&&a!=h.Pair.Item1;}
public static bool WriteAlias(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.Pair.Item1;Item b=a;h.Pair=(new Item(),2);a.V=7;return b.V==7&&h.Pair.Item1.V==0&&a==b;}
public static bool NestedTuple(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.Nested.Item1.Item1;h.Nested=((new Item(),2),3);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&h.Nested.Item1.Item1.V==0;}
public static bool TupleLocal(){Holder h=new Holder();(Item,int)t=h.Pair;h.Pair=(new Item(),2);t.Item1.V=7;return t.Item1.V==7&&h.Pair.Item1.V==0;}
public static bool ListEntry(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.Rows.Add((a,1));h.Rows[0]=(new Item(),2);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&h.Rows[0].Item1.V==0;}
public static bool MapEntry(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.Map["a"]=(a,1);h.Map["a"]=(new Item(),2);return a.V==0&&h.Map["a"].Item2==2;}
public static bool ListInsideTuple(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.ListPair=([a],1);h.ListPair=([],2);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&h.ListPair.Item1.Count==0;}
public static bool DictionaryInsideTuple(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.MapPair=({"a":a},1);h.MapPair=({},2);return a.V==0&&h.MapPair.Item1.Count==0;}
public static bool TwoChildren(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.Two.Item1;Item b=h.Two.Item2;h.Two=(new Item(),new Item());a.V=7;b.V=8;return a.V==7&&b.V==8&&a!=b;}
public static bool Uncaptured(){Holder h=new Holder();h.Pair=(new Item(),2);return h.Pair.Item1.V==0&&h.Pair.Item2==2;}
public static bool DirectControl(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.Items.Add(a);h.Items[0]=new Item();return a.V==0;}
public static bool Repeated(){Holder h=new Holder();for(int i=0;i<5;i++){Item a=h.Pair.Item1;h.Pair=(new Item(),i);a.V=i;if(a.V!=i){return false;}}return h.Pair.Item2==4;}
public static bool Nullable(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=new Item();h.Maybe=(a,1);h.Maybe=(null,2);return a.V==0&&h.Maybe.Item1==null;}
public static bool Generic(){Generic<Item> g=new Generic<Item>();Item a=new Item();g.Rows.Add((a,1));g.Rows[0]=(new Item(),2);return a.V==0;}
public static bool ChildOnly(){Holder h=new Holder();Item a=h.ParentPair.Item1.Child;h.ParentPair=(new Parent(),2);a.V=7;return a.V==7&&h.ParentPair.Item1.Child.V==0;}
public static bool ParentAndChild(){Holder h=new Holder();Parent p=h.ParentPair.Item1;Item a=p.Child;h.ParentPair=(new Parent(),2);a.V=7;return p.Child==a&&p.Child.V==7;}
public static Item Replace(Holder h){Item a=h.Pair.Item1;h.Pair=(new Item(),2);return a;}
public static void Swap(Holder h){h.Pair=(new Item(),2);}
public static Holder Create(){return new Holder();}
